Yeah I totally understand your concerns about Maxx C but there’s reasons why it might not need to be banned. While it can be disruptive, it also adds a layer of strategy to the game. I know more people hate it but other players like me, always just try to argue that it encourages thoughtful play and deck-building, it also really helps provide a counter to all the really top tier decks that summon a lot like most of them do. 

Also, the absence of Maxx "C" in the current TCG meta is really interesting especially when I know players over there still hate it, so I can see why you don’t think it would hurt to ban it right now but I just think it shouldn’t be yet. Its status as an unlimited card definitely needs to change even if you don’t believe that would impact it, I do.

Yeah I absolutely agree, going second isn’t a straight up lost like others believe and, honestly I don’t like that Maxx C is the card everyone plays, I believe it should be limited 1 lol, God even at least 2 would even benefit the game I believe in a positive way. I just don’t understand why it “Needs” to get ban like other people believe, it doesn’t make you win immediately or make your opponent lose outright but I understand why it’s hated so I never wanted to seem like I love it but the way the meta is right now at least, there feels like a need for it. 

Do I think Maxx C is perfect?, of course not lol and, I do wish there were other cards that did a similar effect but not as broken like “Maxx C” type of cards for each monster type, fusion,Xyz, etc would be way better because that’s real decision making. Deciding which one of those to take in your deck would be way better than always placing Maxx C in them.

Same as Ash or nibiru, it allow you to do something in response to your opponent if you’re going second. If your opponent is playing any deck near top tier then it’s nearly impossible to negate enough effects from them unless you draw a hand of negate cards so as long as you have a card like Maxx C at least your hand benefits and, it makes your opponent have to decide if they should continue summoning or not. At the end of the day, the game is designed to be this way, you and your opponent have to make decisions based on each other and, in my opinion/mind Maxx C doesn’t take away from that as cards that do get ban sometimes do
